prompts.environment: Use case: stylized-concept. Production 2D isometric game sprite atlas, TRUE TRANSPARENT alpha background. Use attached Living Garden concept ONLY as visual style reference. Create EXACTLY 4 equal columns by 2 equal rows, 8 isolated cutout diorama sprites. Camera orthographic isometric from above at 35 degrees, view front and right walls; consistent scale, colorful polished soft 3D-rendered toy style, warm wooden materials, lush green plants. No UI, no text, no labels, no grid, no people, no fake transparency checkerboard, no shadows on a backdrop. Each sprite has a compact grass/soil ground-contact base and enough 15% transparent margins to avoid crossing cell borders. Exact reading order left-to-right top row then bottom row: 1. a compact wood-framed glass greenhouse full of colorful seedlings; 2. a wooden compost bin with dark soil, leaves, small shovel and compost sack; 3. an isolated short winding blue stream with one small stone waterfall, reeds and rocks on a compact grass island; 4. a small outdoor field-research desk with open botanical journal, magnifying glass, pots and seed jars; 5. an open wooden seed chest with bright little seed packets and glass jars; 6. a lush pink blossom tree with thick trunk and compact round canopy; 7. a magical purple blossom tree with hanging warm lanterns and cyan glimmering flowers; 8. a small cyan-blue crystal rock garden surrounded by flowers and grass. Whole object visible, no cropping. Rich readable shapes suited for an Android isometric farm. Landscape canvas 2:1 proportion. Keep each asset completely separated and grounded.

prompts.crystal_growth: Use case: stylized-concept. Production 2D isometric farm game growth-stage sprite atlas, real transparent alpha. Exactly 4 equal columns and 2 equal rows (8 sprites). Same compact diamond-shaped tilled-soil farm bed and same camera/scale in every cell, viewed orthographic isometric from above 35 degrees. Soft polished colorful 3D rendered farming game art. Top row ordinary red strawberry plant stages left to right: 1 newly planted seed just sprouting with tiny two green leaves in soil; 2 young leafy strawberry plants; 3 mature leafy plants with white flowers and tiny pale-green unripe fruit; 4 lush plants with plentiful ripe red strawberries ready to harvest. Bottom row CRYSTAL strawberry cultivar, same stages left to right: 1 tiny sprout with subtle cyan glimmer; 2 young green plants with pale-blue leaf veins; 3 white flowers and tiny pale-blue unripe berries; 4 lush green plants with ripe large faceted CYAN BLUE CRYSTAL STRAWBERRIES, sparkling gently, clearly strawberry shaped. Crystal stems remain organic green, only ripe fruit looks faceted. No people, no fences, no buildings, no labels, no text, no grid, no seed packets, no tools, no decorative icons, no shadows outside beds. Uniform generous transparent margins, each soil diamond identical dimensions, all 8 ground anchors aligned. Landscape canvas 2:1. Separate sprites never cross cell borders.
